tasks.title: Announcement #8
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement on the school intercom.
tasks.transcript: Hello,everyone. All student report cards were handed out today. These report cards need to be signed by your parents and brought back to school as soon as possible. When you are leaving school,check the bulletin boards. We've posted the list for the honor roll. Many of you will be happy to see your names on the list.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To inform students the list of honor roll.
options.B: To tell the students what they will do with the report card.
options.C: To give report cards and honor roll to students.
options.D: To ask students to decorate the bulletin board.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问这段通知的目的，属于主旨/目的理解题，需抓住通知的核心内容。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 通知中提到光荣榜名单已张贴，但这只是通知中的一部分信息，并非主要目的。 选项B：正确。 通知明确告知学生成绩单已发放，需要家长签字后尽快带回学校，这是通知的核心内容。 选项C：错误。 成绩单已发放完毕，通知并非要再次发放；光荣榜名单已张贴，也不是在通知中直接发给学生。 选项D：错误。 通知中没有提到让学生装饰公告栏，属于无中生有。

questions.stem: What will the students probably do as they're leaving school?

options.A: Add their names to the honor list
options.B: Call their parents for a ride home
options.C: Post their report cards on the bulletin board
options.D: Check the honor roll list on the bulletin board

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问学生离开学校时很可能做什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住通知中对学生离校时的具体指示。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 光荣榜名单已经由学校张贴，学生不需要自己添加名字。 选项B：错误。 通知中没有提到给家长打电话要搭车回家，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 通知要求成绩单需要家长签字后带回学校，而非张贴在公告栏上。 选项D：正确。 通知明确说“When you are leaving school, check the bulletin boards. We've posted the list for the honor roll.”，因此学生离校时应查看公告栏上的光荣榜名单。
